packages.name: Singapore Essential
packages.description: Singapore is a vibrant island city-state in Southeast Asia that combines futuristic skyscrapers, rich multicultural heritage, and lush green spaces

destination.name: Singapore
destination.description: The Lion City, famous for its modern skyline, Gardens by the Bay, Marina Bay Sands, clean streets, and diverse cuisine.

itinerary.title: Colonial Roots & Futuristic Skylines
itinerary.description: Morning — Civic District & Merlion. Afternoon — Chinatown Culture & Hawker Lunch. Evening — Gardens by the Bay

itinerary.title: Cultural Enclaves & Sky-High Views
itinerary.description: Morning — Little India: Immerse your senses in the vibrant colors and aromas of Little India. Afternoon — Kampong Glam & Haji Lane: Walk or take a short train ride to Kampong Glam. Evening — Marina Bay Sands Sunset: Head to the iconic Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck around 5:30 PM.

itinerary.title: Island Playground & A Grand Finale
itinerary.description: Morning & Afternoon — Sentosa Island: Take the scenic cable car route over to Sentosa Island. Late Afternoon — The Jewel Changi Grand Finale: Plan to head back toward Jewel Changi Airport about 3 to 4 hours before your flight (or dedicate your final evening here)

inclusions: Gardens by the Bay Public Grounds

packages.name: Paris - The City of Light
packages.description: Paris is a natural starting point for guided tours that pair landmark sights with time to soak up café culture and neighbourhood charm. Many itineraries include a city tour, plus classic moments such as a River Seine cruise, views from the Eiffel Tower, and an excursion to Versailles. Beyond the capital, routes often introduce northern France, with stops such as Rouen and Normandy, while other trips travel via Lyon, Dijon or Strasbourg before returning to Paris

destination.name: Paris
destination.description: The City of Love, celebrated for the Eiffel Tower, world-class museums, elegant streets, and romantic atmosphere.

itinerary.title: Iconic Landmarks & Historic Walking Tour
itinerary.description: Morning arrival in Paris followed by hotel check-in. Spend the afternoon exploring the banks of the Seine, walking through the Tuileries Garden, and visiting the historic Sainte-Chapelle chapel. End your evening taking in the panoramic views and glittering lights from the Eiffel Tower.

itinerary.title: World-Class Art & Trendy Le Marais
itinerary.description: Dedicate your morning to exploring the vast masterpiece collections of the Louvre Museum. In the afternoon, head east to the vibrant Le Marais neighborhood to explore its medieval architecture, trendy boutiques, and famous food scene on Rue des Rosiers.

itinerary.title: Bohemian Montmartre & Scenic Seine Cruise
itinerary.description: Spend the morning wandering the steep cobblestone streets, portrait artist squares, and the Sacré-Cœur Basilica in hilltop Montmartre. In the afternoon, descend to the historic Saint-Germain-des-Prés district for sidewalk café culture, and wrap up the day with a relaxing sunset river cruise.

itinerary.title: Palace of Versailles Day Trip & Departure
itinerary.description: Take a short RER train ride to the magnificent Palace of Versailles to tour the Hall of Mirrors and its expansive manicured gardens. Return to central Paris in the afternoon to retrieve your luggage and depart for the airport or train station.

transport.type: Private Premium Chauffeur & SNCF TGV Train
